text:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — onboarding friction with the new next-lite-workspace starter + LangChain sample. Followed README, set RW_API_KEY, but requests from the Next API route intermittently return 401 and the JS SDK doesn't retry. ISR pages fail in prod. Repro steps below, any quick pointers? cc @Samir

Maya Patel: Repro snippet:
```js
// pages/api/generate.js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/js-sdk'
const client = createClient(process.env.RW_API_KEY)
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/mini-beta', prompt: req.body.prompt })
  res.json(out)
}
```

Samir Khan: Thanks — do you mean the hosted API key (project key) or ephemeral session tokens? JS SDK should retry on 429/5xx but not 401. If keys rotate we expect token refresh flow. Can you paste the request/response headers or logs?

Maya Patel: Using project key (not ephemeral). Logs show a 401 then the edge route returns a 500 because we don't catch it:
```
2026-02-12T14:05:22Z INFO incoming request /api/generate
2026-02-12T14:05:22Z WARN upstream 401 Unauthorized (x-rw-error="invalid_api_key")
2026-02-12T14:05:22Z ERROR handler uncaught exception -> 500
```
I also see `x-rw-exp: 167...` sometimes in responses.

Tess Johnson: This rings a bell — there's an SDK parity gap. Python client added a token-refresh helper in 0.3.x that watches rotation headers; JS client hasn't implemented the same pattern yet. Workaround: re-create the client per-request or call a refresh endpoint before SSR. Also noticed telemetry for the sample wasn't enabled so we couldn't correlate onboarding failures.

Owen Lee: I can repro locally with a short-lived key simulation. It looks like the JS client caches the key and ignores `x-rw-exp` if used in serverless SSR context. Quick patch idea: if `x-rw-exp` < now + 10s, force a refresh and retry once. I'll draft a PR.

Devex Bot: deploy-bot: Deployed branch devex/sdk-token-refresh-proto to staging (build 523) :rocket:

Infra QA: We should add an e2e test that simulates short-lived keys and asserts the SDK refresh+retry behavior. Also add a smoke test to the next-starter CI to catch regressions on auth/retry. Suggest adding a test under devex/e2e/auth-rotation.spec.ts.

Samir Khan: I'll own the tests. Owen — please open the PR for the client change and include a small repro in the tests. Tess — can you flip the telemetry flag for the sample so we can see adoption and error rates?

Tess Johnson: On it. I'll add the flag and update the starter README to recommend using `getServerSideProps` with a short-lived refresh helper for now, and note we'll update when the SDK lands.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — saving notes into the starter repo. I'll re-run the onboarding flow tomorrow after the staging deploy and report back.

Owen Lee: PR draft up in a few hrs, will link here.

Infra QA: Assigning issue DEVEX-3987 to Samir + Owen for test + fix.

Samir Khan: Cool, thanks. I'll also add a small changelog entry for the starter warning.

Maya Patel: :thumbsup:
